name: Pearl
overview: Scripture presents the pearl as a symbol of great value and purity, as exemplified in the parable of the pearl of great price, where a man sells all he has to obtain it, illustrating the incomparable worth of the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 13:46). Pearls are also mentioned in the context of adornment, highlighting the call for modesty and humility in Christian conduct (1 Timothy 2:9), while in Revelation they signify wealth and allure but also the potential for corruption when associated with idolatry and immorality (Revelation 17:4; 18:12). Additionally, Jesus warns against casting holy things, likened to pearls, before those who will not appreciate them, emphasizing discernment in sharing spiritual truths (Matthew 7:6). The value placed on pearls contrasts with earthly riches, underscoring spiritual wisdom as surpassing material wealth (Job 28:18).
